YAVAPAI COUNTY TREASURER
NOTICE OF TAX LIEN — FINAL REDEMPTION PERIOD

Parcel No: 304-12-058A
Situs Address: 4120 Mountain Vista Rd, Prescott, AZ 86301
Assessed Owner: DELGADO FAMILY TRUST

You are hereby notified that the above-referenced parcel was sold at tax-lien auction on February 18, 2023, to STERLING LAND INVESTMENTS LLC (Certificate of Purchase No. 2023-04182).

The statutory three-year redemption period for this tax lien expires on FEBRUARY 18, 2026. After that date, the certificate holder is entitled to apply for a Treasurer's Deed conveying fee simple title to the parcel, and all redemption rights of the owner and any lienholders will be FOREVER EXTINGUISHED.

To redeem this parcel, the owner or any party in interest must pay the following amount on or before the redemption deadline:

  Original tax lien amount:         $2,418.00
  Interest (16% per annum, 3 years):  $1,160.64
  Subsequent taxes (2023-2025):     $6,870.00
  Subsequent-tax interest:            $549.60
  Fees and costs:                     $158.00
  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  TOTAL DUE TO REDEEM:             $11,156.24

Payment must be made in cash, certified funds, or cashier's check to the Yavapai County Treasurer.

REDEMPTION DEADLINE: FEBRUARY 18, 2026 — 5:00 PM LOCAL TIME

After this date, no redemption will be accepted and the property will be lost.

anomalies.reason: Three-year statutory redemption period ends in <30 days. After Feb 18, 2026 all owner redemption rights are extinguished and the certificate holder can apply for a Treasurer's Deed.
